messages:
Rae: Quick poll idea 10am taco truck lunch vs 1pm pinball afterwork? Thinking tacos at the corner truck + pinball for whoever can stay. Thoughts? :taco: :joystick:
Omar: Tacos for sure. Midday is perfect. Can we get veggie options?
Jun: I vote tacos + pinball later. I'll be at the office all day so both work.
Maya: Late lunch works. I can bring cash for the taco run. Also can we order ahead if it's busy?
Rae: Good call I'll ask the truck if they take pre-orders for 10. Poll in 24h.
SnackBot: Poll created: "10am taco truck vs 1pm pinball" (24h).
Omar: Add Omar to RSVP. Veggie tacos pls.
Jun: Add Jun. Happy to cover extra napkins.
SnackBot: Poll results: Tacos 7 votes, Pinball 3 votes. Outcome: Taco truck lunch confirmed at 10:15am. Truck: El Camino Tacos (link: https://elcamino.example). Pre-order requested for 10.
Rae: Placed pre-order for 10 (mix: 4 beef, 4 veggie, 2 chicken). Bring $12 cash to cover your share.
Maya: Thanks! I'll collect cash at 9:50 and bring a small change jar.
Jun: See you at the corner. If anyone needs a ride from BART I can swing by.
Omar: Perfect, thanks @Jun and @Rae. See y'all :)
Rae: Closing thread  will DM any last-minute notes.
